> Thank you for your contribution to the Sandboxie repository.
>
> Please provide commit messages and pull request descriptions in English language.
>
> Translators are encouraged to look at the localization notes and tips: https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/discussions/1123
>
> For translation changes, follow the [translation collaboration and attribution guidelines](https://github.com/sandboxie-plus/Sandboxie/blob/master/TRANSLATING.md#translation-collaboration-and-attribution). Preserve existing credits unless a project maintainer explicitly approves an attribution change, and agree on substantial terminology changes or broad rewrites with the language maintainer and project maintainers first.
